title: Utillian 5 Wax Pen Concentrate Vape Device
description:
Description
Specifications
This Kit Includes
The Utillian 5 Wax Pen features a massive 1500mah battery, 4 heat settings, 2 black ceramic coils for better extraction, a USB charging port and is an absolute workhorse.
The Utillian 5 features 4 voltage settings giving you tons of flexibility over your wax session. The voltage settings react a bit differently depending on what atomizer you are using. But in general, if you are looking for better flavor and thinner vapor, the lowest 2 settings are recommended. If you are looking for some serious clouds the top 2 heating settings on the Utillian 5 vape pen have you covered.
The included jumbo twisted kanthal coil is extremely versatile. Capable of handling both large and small loads of concentrates, the 4mm coil has tons of service area for maximum vaporization. The kanthal coil is twisted around a black ceramic coil for superior wicking.
The triple titanium coil is geared towards heavy hitters and large loads. 3 coils provides a substantial amount of heat and surface area to make quick work of even larger loads of wax. The triple titanium coil is wrapped around black ceramic rods which are porous in nature to allow you wax to wick, rather than slip off the coils.
